findings.title: config() can be called by anyone until the first initialization, so an attacker can claim admin
findings.evidence: lib.rs:280 `admin.require_auth();` · lib.rs:284 `if admin != config.admin {` · lib.rs:269 `Updates the contract configuration parameters. Can be invoked only by the admin account.`

findings.title: set_admin writes the admin key with no authorization, so config() lets anyone install themselves as admin before initialization
Zero stored price reaches cross-price division, so x_price/x_twap panic for every pair using that asset
div_floor is missing 'return' for zero inputs, so zero prices reach ilog10 and division by zero
prices() does not step back in time when a record is missing, so twap/prices return fewer or no records across a gap
Duplicate assets in one add/config batch are both accepted, so the asset index and list disagree
Asset indexes are truncated to u8, so more than 256 assets alias to the same price slots
Price TTL is truncated from u64 to u32 without a bound check
Instance storage (admin, config, asset index) is only TTL-extended through a public bump(), and set_price never extends it
